Commentary.Commentary: 104 is the target for Pakistan to inflict a 3-0 whitewash. Does not look like West Indies have enough arsenal to change that scoreline. However, can they make a fight of the same as a prelude to the upcoming ODI series? Stay tuned to find out during the run chase...

Pakistan were simply brilliant. Imad Wasim set the tone early, with wickets in successive balls in his second over and the hosts never looked back. It looked like a warm-up game where all the bowlers got a decent outing.

That ends yet another poor display with the bat for the Windies. They were never in the game and not once did they get going. Samuels played a long hand of 42 in the middle, with some help from Kieron Pollard, their 37-run stand giving some respectability to the total. However, it does not look competitive, to be honest.

Last ball of the innings and Amir knows Samuels wants to go for it. He pitches it wide down the leg side and Samuels chases it, swinging his bat. He misjudges that length delivery and is hit high on the pads. Amir smiles and that WEST INDIES FINISH THEIR INNINGS ON 103/5!
Landed around leg, Pollard misses his flick and is hit on the pads. The ball rolls down to third man and the batsmen take a leg bye.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. Two runs added to the total.
Fullish on middle and leg, pushed down to long on for a run.
ON THE BOX! A short ball outside leg, Samuels is early into his pull and is hit right on the unmentionable area.
Full on middle, heaved to long on for a single.
Length ball on the pads, Pollard looks to play it but misses. The ball swings in and hits him on the thigh pad. One run added as the umpire signals a leg bye.
Fuller ball outside off, Samuels reaches across and drives it through the covers for a single.
A yorker on middle and leg, Pollard does well to drive it through mid off for a single.
BEATEN! Beauty of a delivery! Full and very little pace, Pollard looks to drive it but misses as the ball swings in a bit. It passes through bat and off stump and goes to the keeper.
Very full on middle and off, Samuels looks to drive it but miscues it to mid-wicket for a single. Very good bowling.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched through the covers.
Fullish delivery on middle an off, Marlon drives it through mid on for a single. Samuels keeps the strike. His score is now 39 off 53 balls and the partnership climbs to 28 of 32 balls.
Shortish delivery on middle and off, Pollard swings for it but edges it onto his pads. A single is taken.
Length ball on off, Samuels whips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on middle and leg, Samuels runs down and drives it to mid on for a couple.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Shorter ball on the stumps, pulled through the leg side for a single.
Amir is back on.
Length ball on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a brace.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They pick up a single.
FOUR! PULLED! Short ball on middle and off, Samuels pulls it through mid-wicket. The ball is hit hard and races between the two fielders in the deep and across the ropes.
Length ball on leg, Samuels loses patience and looks to slog it. He misses it and is struck on his pads.
Shorter ball on leg, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Pollard flicks it away with a wristy shot to the leg side for a brace.
Tanvir is back on.
Shorter ball on off, Samuels looks to play it but misses and the ball goes over the stumps.
Full delivery outside off, Samuels opens the face of his bat and guides it to third man.
On the pads, flicked to square leg for a single.
On middle, Marlon works it down the leg side for a single.
Shorter ball on the stumps, Samuels pulls it to the off side.
Fuller ball on middle and off, driven back to the bowler.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
A quicker bouncer on the stumps, Samuels looks to slog it but gets a top edge over the bowler's head. He is safe though as no fielders are there. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Length ball on off, pushed to the covers.
Samuels rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
Length ball on middle and leg, Samuels plays an awkward shot. He looks to push it to mid on but the ball comes off the ground and splices off the outside edge of the bat to go to point.
Short ball around off, a bit of pace, punched off the back foot to the covers for a single.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is back on.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Full and outside off, Samuels feels for it but is beaten.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Full on off, driven through the covers for a single.
Played to the point region by Samuels.
Kieron Pollard is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pooran falls for the set up! Pitched a bit short on the stumps, Pooran strides forward and looks to replicate his earlier shot. He slog sweeps it and the ball goes up over mid-wicket. It looks like he has got it across the ropes but it dips just inside the boundary. Shoaib Malik pouches it and that spells the end of Nicholas Pooran. That was a woeful shot, one that exposed his lack of experience. End of a 35-run partnership.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman. Wide signalled by the umpire.

SIX! SKY HIGH! Spinning into the batsman, Nicholas fancies his chances and gets down on one knee. He times it perfectly and slogs it high over mid-wicket. The ball is outlined by the night sky then vanishes into the crowd for a maximum.
Landed on the stumps, Pooran flicks it to the leg side.
Flighted around off, Samuels drives it through mid off for a single.
Nawaz is back on.
Full on middle and off, pushed off the front foot back to the bowler.
Slower ball outside off, angled across once more, Samuels plays it to the off side for a single.
BEATEN! Again, the ball comes angled across and Samuels looks to play it and misses.
BEATEN! Length ball angled across, Samuels looks to push it but the ball feathers past the outside edge of the bat to the keeper.
Full on the stumps, driven through mid on for a single.
Full outside off, Nicholas wastes no time in greeting the new bowler. He slashes at it and the ball goes through point for a couple.
RUMMAN RAEES gets a chance to showcase his skills. He is a left-arm seamer.
Full outside off, driven through the covers for a brace.
Flighted on the stumps, Pooran gets down on one knee and swings at it. The batsmen pick up a single.
Pooran flicks it away with a wristy shot through point. Two runs added to the total.
Served on the pads, flicked off the pads for a single.
FOUR! Samuels digs in! Shorter ball outside off, Samuels cuts it through the point for a boundary.
Full on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
Fuller ball down the leg side, Samuels flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single.
Shorter ball, punched off the back foot.

FOUR! Cleanly struck! Full on off, Samuels drives it. He plays it across and the ball races through mid on. Amir comes running to his right and dives to stop it in the deep but the ball touches his hand and crosses the ropes.
Full and flighted outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Short around off, punched off the back foot to the covers for a single.
Floated on the pads, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Samuels has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full around off, driven through the covers. It is stopped in the deep and the batsmen get a brace.
Flighted on the stumps, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter ball outside off, Samuels waits for it and cuts it to gully. The fielder makes a good stop and the batsmen get a single.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Nicholas Pooran is the next batsman in.

OUT! Bowled! That is the third wicket for Wasim! Nothing different from the other two wicket-taking deliveries. Full and flat around off, Bravo looks to hit this through the off side but is far away from the ball and he drags it on! The ball hits the leg stump. Wasim now has figures of 2.1-1-6-3!
IMAD WASIM is back on.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Pitched on leg, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Straight on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Full on the stumps, pushed through mid-off.
Floated on the pads, Samuels works it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, played to point for a single.
Shoaib Malik comes into the attack.
Full around off, driven to mid off. Samuels goes for a single but the bowler runs to his left and throws it at the stumps to send the batsman back to the crease.
Driven through mid-off by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shorter delivery, Samuels rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball for a single.
Landed outside off, driven well through the covers.
Full on off, pushed to point.
Served on the stumps, defended to the off side.
FOUR! FIRED! Full outside off, Bravo is on this like a hawk. He opens the face of his bat and drives it through backward point for a boundary.
Length ball on off, Bravo defends it from within the crease to mid on.
Full outside off, Bravo drives it through the covers.
Fuller ball outside off, played to point for a single.
Length ball wide outside off, Samuels swings at it but misses.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Here comes the newly married man, MOHAMMAD AMIR.
Tossed up outside off, punched off the back foot.
FOUR! Bravo makes his presence felt! Full on the pads, Dwayne flicks it hard. That was solidly struck and makes it past the square leg fielder for a boundary.
DWAYNE BRAVO walks in at number 5, replacing Fletcher.

OUT! Fletcher stumbles and Sarfraz capitalises on it! Floated on the stumps, Fletcher dabs it to square leg. He runs forward hurriedly but there was never a run there. Mid-pitch he decides to run back but slips on and falls on one knee. The fielder throws it high and Sarfraz jumps up to catch it. The batsman is way out of the crease and the keeper removes the bails. West Indies are not doing well.
Flighted outside off, Fletcher runs forward and defends it to the off side for single.
Flighted on middle and leg, very full delivery, played to point for a single.
Floated on off, punched off the back foot to the covers.
MOHAMMAD NAWAZ to bowl now.

Nearly a boundary! Full on off, Fletcher steps forward and lofts it. That was a good stroke, with contact made on the toe of the bat and the ball goes over the covers. Unfortunately for the batsman, it lands in the outfield and doesn't cross the ropes. The batsmen manage to run a couple.
Full outside off, Fletcher helps it to the point region.
Fuller ball outside off, pushed to point.
Length ball outside off, Fletcher frees his arms and cuts it through the covers.
Fullish ball outside off, Fletcher looks to play it but is beaten up.
Outside off, played to point for a single.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Darted on the pads, Samuels looks to defend but the ball hits his pads and deflects to the leg side.
No, Imad cannot get the hat-trick. It was a good ball though, full and arrowed in on middle, Samuels manages to keep it out in a hurry.
MARLON SAMUELS walks in at number 4, replacing Walton, to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Dragged on! Imad gets two in two! A tad shorter again, Walton goes back in his crease to push it to the bowler but the ball stays low, takes the under edge and hits the stumps. Can he get a hat-trick?
Chadwick Walton is the new man in.
OUT! Imad gets the breakthrough! Tossed up on the stumps and spinning in, Charles looks to sweep it again but the ball goes past him. It turns in a bit and hits the stumps.
Flighted down the leg side, Charles looks to sweep but is hit on the pads. There is an appeal from the bowler but the umpire isn't interested.
Length ball around off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Full outside off, driven to mid off for a single. Fletcher goes for a single and there is a throwing on the striker's end but Sarfraz is a tad too late and the batsman makes it in.
Fuller ball down the leg side, Fletcher looks to play it but is hit on the pads. The fielding side appeals but the umpire doesn't give it.
Full on middle, Fletcher does well to defend it.
FOUR! West Indies are off to a confident start! Fullish ball on the pads, Fletcher works it neatly through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller ball around off, pushed to the covers.
Sohail Tanvir to bowl from the other end.
Tossed up on the stumps, whipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter ball outside off, Fletcher punches it off the back foot to the covers.
Flighted on off, driven to mid on for a single.
Full on middle, pushed wide of mid on for a single.
The batsman has been struck on the pads as he looked to play that off the front foot.
Full on middle, Charles flicks it behind square leg. Some good running helps them take three runs.
The players are out in the middle! Johnson Charles and Andre Fletcher will open for West Indies. Imad Wasim to start off proceedings with the ball. Here we go...

West Indies playing XI - Johnson Charles, Andre Fletcher(wk), Marlon Samuels, Chadwick Walton, Dwayne Bravo, Kieron Pollard, Nicholas Pooran, Carlos Brathwaite(c), Sunil Narine, Jerome Taylor, Kesrick Williams
Pakistan playing XI - Sharjeel Khan, Khalid Latif, Babar Azam, Shoaib Malik, Umar Akmal, Sarfraz Ahmed(c/wk), Mohammad Nawaz, Imad Wasim, Sohail Tanvir, Mohammad Amir, Rumman Raees

West Indies captain, Carlos Brathwaite says that he is batting first and that this is a nice track. Adds that they will see how it goes after 3-4 overs and capitalize on the situation better. (On the size of the outfield) Says that they have discussed it in the dressing room and it depends on how they execute their plans in the next twenty overs. Says that they will go out there and do what is needed as with ever game. Says that his team will plays for personal pride and for the millions of fans at home who are looking forward to this match. Says that they have made two changes to the side. Samuel Badree has a sore groin and will be replaced by Kesrick Williams and Chadwick Walton will walk in for Evin Lewis.

Pakistan captain, Sarfraz Ahmed says that he will bowl first as this is a good pitch and that the dew factor is expected to arrive later. Adds that they have never whitewashed West Indies before and are confident of doing so this time. Repeats that they are a happy and confident side. Two changes to the side - Wahab Riaz and Hasan Ali are replaced by Mohammad Amir and Rumman Raees.
Toss - Pakistan win the toss and choose to bowl.

Pitch report - Bazid Khan says that the pitch does not have a lot of grass and is pretty hard. It has a little bit of shine which means that it is good for batting. The dimensions of the ground are even bigger than the one at Dubai. This could pose a challenge for West Indies. Says that West Indies have displayed one-dimensional batting so far, and their boundaries did not work on the bigger ground. Ends by says that the pitch means better batting performance and there are no demons in it.

The visitors struggled with the weather and have failed to show up with the bat. But they are specialists in the shortest format and are very capable of getting the win to save face. Will Pakistan keep it up or will the World Champions finally fight back and show them who the world bosses are?

Hello and welcome to the third and final T20I of the series between Pakistan and West Indies in Abu Dhabhi. The big question for today's match is whether Pakistan will continue their winning streak and whitewash West Indies. They have so far dominated in their adopted home ground, with their bowlers creating havoc for the Windies batsmen while Pakistan's batsmen have been consistently solid.
